# Guided setup

An invented PRD for the plan model's tests: every name and number is made up.

## Goals

Activation first, then Growth.

## Milestones

| Milestone | Name | Start | End | Engineer-weeks | Done when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | Prove it | 2 Nov 2026 | 27 Nov 2026 | 8 | Ten teams finish setup; the checklist is live |
| M2 | Scale volume | 30 Nov 2026 | 25 Dec 2026 | 8 | Import handles 1,000 rows |
| M3 | Open to all | 28 Dec 2026 | 12 Feb 2027 | 12 | Every new team sees the checklist |

No-work week: 28 Dec 2026 - 1 Jan 2027 (year-end break)

## Targets

| Goal | M1 | M2 | M3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Activation | 40% of new teams finish setup | 55% of new teams finish setup | 65% of new teams finish setup |
| Growth | 20 weekly active teams | 100 weekly active teams | 250 weekly active teams |
